command:
bash -lc '
OUT=/tmp/c720p-oauth-verify-990021.out
: > "$OUT"
PY=""
for p in /opt/inbox-triage-agent/.venv/bin/python /opt/inbox-triage-agent/venv/bin/python /opt/inbox-triage-agent/.venv/bin/python3 /opt/inbox-triage-agent/venv/bin/python3; do [ -x "$p" ] && PY="$p" && break; done
echo PY=$PY >> "$OUT"
if [ -n "$PY" ]; then
  "$PY" - <<'"'"'PY'"'"' >> "$OUT" 2>&1
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/inbox-triage-agent')
from triage_agent import load_config,gmail_service,token_path
accounts=[str(x) for x in load_config().get('gmail_accounts',[]) if str(x).strip()]
print('ACCOUNTS_TOTAL='+str(len(accounts)))
ok=0
for i,a in enumerate(accounts,1):
    try:
        p=token_path(a)
        print(f'TOKEN_{i}_EXISTS={p.exists()}')
        prof=gmail_service(a).users().getProfile(userId='me').execute()
        actual=str(prof.get('emailAddress') or '')
        print(f'ACCOUNT_{i}_OK=1')
        print(f'ACCOUNT_{i}_MATCH={int(actual.lower()==a.lower())}')
        ok+=1
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ACCOUNT_{i}_OK=0')
        print(f'ACCOUNT_{i}_ERR={type(e).__name__}:{str(e)[:200]}')
print('ACCOUNTS_OK='+str(ok))
PY
fi
echo UNITS_BEGIN >> "$OUT"
systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei "mail|triage|inbox" >> "$OUT" || true
echo UNITS_END >> "$OUT"
python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json,pathlib,urllib.request,time,re
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/c720p-oauth-verify-990021.out').read_text(errors='ignore')[-6000:]
m_total=re.search(r'ACCOUNTS_TOTAL=(\d+)',out); m_ok=re.search(r'ACCOUNTS_OK=(\d+)',out)
total=int(m_total.group(1)) if m_total else 0; ok=int(m_ok.group(1)) if m_ok else 0
token=pathlib.Path('/home/jespern/.config/c720p-agent/security-token').read_text().strip()
payload={'observed_at':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'maintenance':{'oauth_production_verify_990021':{'ok':bool(total and ok==total),'accounts_total':total,'accounts_ok':ok,'output':out}}}
req=urllib.request.Request('https://uiqntazgnrxwliaidkmy.supabase.co/functions/v1/c720p-security-control?action=health',data=json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':')).encode(),method='POST',headers={'content-type':'application/json','x-c720p-token':token})
try:
 r=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15); print('HEALTH_POST',r.status); r.close()
except Exception as e: print('HEALTH_POST_ERR',type(e).__name__,str(e)[:160])
PY
cat "$OUT"
'
